tasks.title: Verify upstream English data and translation availability
tasks.notes: RESOLVED 2026-11-25. Upstream ships a root-level `translations` JSONPath array plus a dictionary at /{mode}/{dataset}_{lang}, keyed by placeholder string, not by path. Measured regular/en: items 25,016/25,016 strings, tasks 3,642/3,642, traders 32/32, zero missing keys. Found 13 stale task pointers and reward customization names absent from the dictionary. Helper implemented in pipeline/src/upstream with 28 tests.

tasks.title: Spike: build one real bundle from the live API and ingest it
tasks.notes: Size half measured 2026-11-25: raw items+maps+tasks = 27.7 MB, zstd -3 = 1.98 MB (items 1.17, maps 0.60, tasks 0.21), so the 10 MB budget has ~5x headroom. Remaining: measure SQLite ingest time with the full localized dataset once the Flutter/drift layer exists; do not change the budget before then.

tasks.title: Decide public project name and branding constraints
tasks.notes: Tarkov is a Battlestate Games trademark. Decide whether to ship as "Tarkov Companion", a neutral name, and confirm the disclaimer wording and absence of official logos. Output: final name in README, NOTICE, and package identifiers.

tasks.title: Confirm license boundary with the GPL-3 upstream API repo
tasks.notes: Upstream the-hideout/tarkov-api is GPL-3.0; this client is MIT and consumes the public API. Confirm that shipping normalized derivative data and an independent client is acceptable, and that NOTICE attribution is sufficient. Output: short note in docs/legal-notes.md.

tasks.title: Approve data freshness cadence and bandwidth budget
tasks.notes: Design assumes a 6-hour pipeline cadence, a 10 MB per-mode compressed budget, and 24 h price freshness. Validate against GitHub Actions minutes, release asset churn, and player expectations. Output: accepted numbers reflected in specs/data-sync and design.md.

tasks.title: Decide pvp-season profile scoping
tasks.notes: Spec assumes one profile per game mode. Seasons reset progress, so a per-season profile may be required. Decide before profiles are implemented; if per-season, update specs/local-profiles and the schema task. Check /pvp-season/season payload for season identity.

tasks.title: Decide Windows code signing approach and budget
tasks.notes: Unsigned installers trigger SmartScreen. Evaluate OV/EV certificate cost, Azure Trusted Signing eligibility for an OSS project, or shipping unsigned with documented verification. Output: chosen path plus release-notes wording.

tasks.title: Define versioning and release policy
tasks.notes: SemVer for app, independent versions for bundle schema and progress format. Define support window (latest only pre-1.0), rollback expectations, and how a bad bundle is withdrawn. Output: docs/release-policy.md.

tasks.title: Configure repository settings for OSS collaboration
tasks.notes: Branch protection on main, required CI checks, Actions workflow permissions (read-only default, write only in release jobs), Dependabot, secret scanning, private vulnerability reporting, issue/PR templates, labels. Output: settings checklist completed and documented.
